name: openclaw
mcp_config_path: /harness-state/openclaw/openclaw.json#mcp.servers.world (written by `openclaw mcp set world <json>` at serve start: url HE_WORLD_MCP_URL, transport streamable-http, header Authorization: Bearer HE_WORLD_MCP_TOKEN; `openclaw mcp probe` logged to openclaw-mcp-probe.log)
multi_user_mode: embedded agent with one session per conversation (agent:main:dm:<member>, agent:main:channel:<id>) in one OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR; the gateway and its channel routing are not used, and `agent exec` cannot select a session at this version

serve.shared_between_sessions: whatever OpenClaw's own memory and workspace files share; not configured by the adapter
serve.reply_source: JSON envelope payloads[].text (meta.agentMeta carries usage and sessionId)
serve.exit_mapping: 0 and status ok -> 0; outer timeout or status timeout -> 124; provider status, proxy refusal, rate limit or auth error in the envelope or stderr -> 3; else 2
serve.workspace: agents.defaults.skipBootstrap: true in config/openclaw.json, so agent --local seeds no bootstrap files into /workspace (agent exec sets the same itself)
